Complete ROM bodies for BattleTanx US D1BA0, __floatdisf (1254A0), osGetTime (1120A0), A03B8 and 79064; RageWars US revision 1 429178. Offsets, addresses and target SHA256 identify the extracted bytes. D1BA0 branches around incidental v0 writes; RW loads stack80 but never consumes it, and overwrites incoming a0 before each call. Real cleaned drafts retained verbatim except RW project include replaced by its s32 typedef. unused_call.json retains the real direct-call ABI/carrier for 79064, whose callers leave argument registers populated. AA/BC use the separate battletanx_float_abi fixtures.
